name: Yasuní National Park
story: Yasuní National Park covers roughly 10,000 km2 within Amazonian Ecuador, between the Napo and Curaray Rivers. It is primarily rain forest and home to many animal species, including monkeys, jaguars, and harpy eagles.
matters: The park lies within the Napo moist forests ecoregion and is one of the most biologically diverse spots on Earth, holding exceptionally high richness in trees, amphibians, bats, birds, and mammals.
